info.title: Rosetta Capability Extensions v1
info.description: Implemented subsets: Application Registration, C1 Registry and bounded C2 direct grants/authorized discovery. C3 is an offline resolver and A1 Audit uses trusted DBAs. Human delegation, resolver HTTP endpoints and C4 invocation/composition remain unimplemented. Hosting is proposed. Per-operation status is authoritative; see CAPABILITY_DIRECT_TRUST.md and CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.md.

post.summary: Accept one guarded pinned capability execution
post.description: C4A opt-in runtime; disabled by default. Requires an enrolled same-tenant backend initiator, live direct invoke grant, exact published version/digest, sideEffects none, approval none and operator-approved HTTPS origin. Only target and input are accepted. The original initiator may replay the same key to reauthenticate untouched work within its original deadline. No composition, delegation, automatic retry or general resume. See CAPABILITY_EXECUTION.md.

get.summary: Read an authorized execution without exposing engine internals
get.description: C4A opt-in runtime; disabled by default. Requires the original enrolled initiator and current bound C2 authority. Authenticated reads reconcile deadline expiry and memory-lease loss. Engine IDs, credentials, ticket hashes and input are not exposed. See CAPABILITY_EXECUTION.md.

post.summary: Enrolled provider redeems one opaque input-bound ticket
post.description: C4A opt-in runtime; disabled by default. The provider must authenticate independently with its enrolled backend OIDC identity. Atomically consumes one input-bound ticket only while the original initiator memory lease, original grant and exact published capability remain eligible. Invalid, expired, replayed or wrong-provider tickets return active false without context. See CAPABILITY_EXECUTION.md.

ExecutionCreate.description: Full design schema. C4A serves only SingleCapabilityExecutionCreate.

ApplicationApprovalCreate.description: Implemented application-only decision. resourceId and requesterAppId must equal the stored appId; requesterSubject, digest and revision must match that app. expiresAt must be future UTC Z within ten minutes; approver must be independent.

DirectGrantCreate.description: Implemented bounded direct subset: one exact capability version/digest and existing operator-verified consumer backend subject only; both delegation flags false. Human delegation is deferred.

GrantApprovalCreate.description: Independent enrolled human with trust.approve; exact current pending grant digest/revision/requester/provider and expiry bounded by ten minutes and grant expiry.

CapabilityApprovalCreate.description: C1 approval for exact capabilityId@version or version UUID; documented bare-ID alias must resolve one exact digest/revision. Malformed resource IDs return 400 before lookup; valid missing/hidden references return 404.
